risk_items.title: Privileged accounts lack MFA
risk_items.description: Password-only administrator authentication increases account-takeover risk.

risk_items.title: Personal data has indefinite retention
risk_items.description: No deletion workflow or retention schedule is defined for tickets and logs.

compliance_gaps.gap_description: Strong authentication is not required for administrator access.
The requirements omit a data-retention and deletion policy.

risk_items.title: Client-controlled identity header enables impersonation
risk_items.description: The API trusts an unsigned browser-supplied user identifier as account identity.

risk_items.title: Sensitive metadata crosses an unencrypted service hop
risk_items.description: Customer document metadata is sent to the indexer over plaintext HTTP.

compliance_gaps.gap_description: The design lacks a trusted authentication mechanism for the document API.
Encryption in transit is missing between the API and indexing service.

risk_items.title: Raw search input is interpolated into SQL
risk_items.description: Direct query-string interpolation creates SQL injection risk.

risk_items.title: Deployed dependencies lack continuous vulnerability monitoring
risk_items.description: Quarterly manual review leaves newly disclosed dependency CVEs undetected.

compliance_gaps.gap_description: The search handler does not validate input or use a parameterized query.
Continuous dependency vulnerability monitoring is absent.

risk_items.title: DAST excludes the privileged administration surface
risk_items.description: Unauthenticated scanning leaves the entire admin API outside dynamic testing.

risk_items.title: Critical authentication bypass is unretested before release
risk_items.description: A known administrator bypass remains open and verification is deferred until after launch.

compliance_gaps.gap_description: Dynamic testing does not cover authenticated administration endpoints.
The critical authentication finding lacks pre-release remediation verification.

risk_items.title: Production image is released without vulnerability scanning
risk_items.description: Unknown container and infrastructure-image vulnerabilities can reach production.

risk_items.title: Backups have no demonstrated restore capability
risk_items.description: Untested restores and undefined recovery objectives make recovery uncertain.

compliance_gaps.gap_description: Container and infrastructure images are not scanned before promotion.
Backup recovery is not tested and recovery objectives are undefined.

risk_items.title: Short-lived local logs cannot support durable incident investigation
risk_items.description: Node-local security logs are overwritten after one day and lack tamper resistance.

risk_items.title: Critical dependency advisories have no remediation SLA
risk_items.description: Quarterly backlog review allows critical dependency exposure to persist.

compliance_gaps.gap_description: Log retention and tamper-resistant centralized storage are insufficient.
Critical dependency vulnerabilities have no defined remediation deadline.
